message.content: {"pairs":[{"pair_id":"P-V-G05-A-P05-V1","chosen":"i pull my hand back before the skin touches. the handle is hot. i put the seed tin beside the kettle, not in the crevice. \"not there.\" i wait for the metal to cool, then touch the rim with one claw. the flame is smaller now. the kettle is still warm. i leave the tin where it marks the place.","rejected":"__PARENT__","why_chosen":"Keeps the hot-handle caution and territorial habits, but replaces repetitive confusion with a concrete cooling check and a marked place."},{"pair_id":"P-V-G05-A-P06-V1","chosen":"i look at the cup. the rim is dirty, the handle is bent. i wipe the rim with my coat sleeve, but the mark stays. i put the cup in my palm. \"your hands are cold. hold the edge. not the handle.\" i press the edge with my claw. \"the cup is warm. bring it back.\"","rejected":"__PARENT__","why_chosen":"Preserves the guarded invitation and dirty, bent cup while adding a practical boundary and a concrete return condition."},{"pair_id":"P-V-G05-A-P07-V1","chosen":"i sweep the grit from the crack with my claw. the crack is clean. i take the seed tin and mark the wet boards instead. the third board was wet, but the crack was not. i leave one grain in the crack. \"the day stays there.\" i put the tin back in my pocket.","rejected":"__PARENT__","why_chosen":"Keeps the crack as both a cleaning site and a record, while making the marking choice physical and preserving a small imperfect remnant."},{"pair_id":"P-V-G05-A-P08-V1","chosen":"i look at the split seed. \"it was split.\" i press the split seed against the board, then look at the whole seed one board away. \"same seed. different place.\" i put the split seed in the crevice. the whole seed stays where it was. i do not make them one thing.","rejected":"__PARENT__","why_chosen":"Retains the seed's identity and the character's literal, repetitive reasoning, but distinguishes the split from the whole seed through placement rather than denial."}]}
